cards.ex: We don't have exact figures yet, but I can give you a ballpark estimate of the costs.
cards.exUz: Bizda hali aniq raqamlar yo'q, lekin men sizga xarajatlarning taxminiy bahosini bera olaman.
cards.uzDef: Aniq emas, lekin yaqin bo'lgan taxminiy qiymat yoki baho.

cards.ex: The poll results have a margin of error of plus or minus three percent.
cards.exUz: So'rov natijalarida plyus yoki minus uch foiz xatolik chegarasi bor.
cards.uzDef: Natijalarning aniqligida bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan xatolik miqdori.

cards.ex: We need a good number cruncher in our finance department.
cards.exUz: Bizning moliya bo'limimizga yaxshi raqam saralovchi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Raqamlar bilan ishlashga ixtisoslashgan odam, masalan, buxgalter yoki moliyaviy tahlilchi.

cards.ex: His behavior was beyond the pale, especially considering the circumstances.
cards.exUz: Uning xatti-harakati, ayniqsa vaziyatni hisobga olganda, me'yordan ortiq edi.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilib bo'lmaydigan darajada, juda yomon yoki xafa qiladigan.

cards.ex: We came up short on the fundraising goal, so we'll have to scale back the project.
cards.exUz: Biz pul yig'ish maqsadiga erisha olmadik, shuning uchun loyihani qisqartirishimiz kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilgan yoki kerakli miqdorni yetkazib bera olmaslik, pul yetishmasligi.

cards.ex: The company cut corners on safety to increase profits, which led to the accident.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya foydani oshirish uchun xavfsizlikda xarajatlarni qisqartirdi, bu esa baxtsiz hodisaga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni kamaytirish uchun nimadir arzonroq yoki tezroq qilish, lekin sifatni pasaytirish.

cards.ex: She's got baking down to a science; her cakes are always perfect.
cards.exUz: U pishiriqni mukammallikka yetkazdi; uning tortlari har doim a'lo darajada.
cards.uzDef: Jarayonni juda samarali va ishonchli qilish, uni mukammallikka yetkazish.

cards.ex: My parents footed the bill for my college education.
cards.exUz: Ota-onam kollejdagi ta'limim uchun to'lovni to'lashdi.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni to'liq qoplash, to'lovni to'liq to'lash.

cards.ex: He built his company from the ground up with hard work and determination.
cards.exUz: U o'z kompaniyasini noldan boshlab qattiq mehnat va qat'iyat bilan qurdi.
cards.uzDef: Hech narsadan boshlab, butunlay yangidan yaratish.

cards.ex: Since the pandemic, housing prices have gone through the roof.
cards.exUz: Pandemiyadan beri uy-joy narxlari oshib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Narxlar juda tez va keskin oshib ketishi.

cards.ex: The government needs to keep tabs on spending to avoid a deficit.
cards.exUz: Hukumat defitsitdan qochish uchun xarajatlarni nazorat qilishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yoki kimnidir diqqat bilan kuzatib borish, nazorat qilish.

cards.ex: The candidate won the election in a landslide victory.
cards.exUz: Nomzod saylovda katta g'alaba qozondi.
cards.uzDef: Saylovda katta farq bilan g'alaba qozonish, juda katta ustunlik.

cards.ex: The new product didn't measure up to the company's expectations.
cards.exUz: Yangi mahsulot kompaniyaning kutganlariga mos kelmadi.
cards.uzDef: Standartlarga yoki kutilganlarga mos kelish, talablarga javob berish.

cards.ex: There's more to this story than meets the eye; I suspect there's a hidden motive.
cards.exUz: Bu hikoyada ko'rinib turganidan ko'ra ko'proq narsa bor; men yashirin maqsad bor deb gumon qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Ko'rinib turganidan ko'ra murakkabroq yoki muhimroq bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: We need to nip this problem in the bud before it gets out of control.
cards.exUz: Biz bu muammoni nazoratdan chiqib ketishidan oldin ildizidan yo'qotishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo kattalashmasdan oldin uni to'xtatib qo'yish, yo'q qilish.

cards.ex: They managed to produce a great film on a shoestring budget.
cards.exUz: Ular juda kam byudjet bilan ajoyib film suratga olishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kam pul bilan, cheklangan resurslar bilan ishlash.

cards.ex: She's one in a million; I'm lucky to have her in my life.
cards.exUz: U yagona va betakror; men uni hayotimda bo'lganimdan baxtiyorman.
cards.uzDef: Juda noyob, kamdan-kam uchraydigan va qimmatli narsa yoki odam.

cards.ex: He's penny-wise, pound-foolish; he saves on cheap gas but ignores car maintenance.
cards.exUz: U arzoniga uchadi; arzon benzin sotib oladi, lekin mashinaga xizmat ko'rsatishga e'tibor bermaydi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik narsalarda tejamkor bo'lish, lekin katta narsalarda beparvo bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company is raking in money since the new product launch.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yangi mahsulot ishga tushirilgandan beri ko'p pul topmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tez va oson yo'l bilan ko'p pul topish.

cards.ex: We need to scale up our operations to meet the growing demand.
cards.exUz: O'sib borayotgan talabni qondirish uchun biz operatsiyalarimizni kengaytirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ishlab chiqarishni yoki biznesni kengaytirish, hajmini oshirish.

cards.ex: Their customer service is second to none; they always go the extra mile.
cards.exUz: Ularning mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatishi eng yaxshisi; ular har doim qo'shimcha harakat qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Barcha boshqalardan ustun, eng yaxshi sifatga ega.

cards.ex: The accountant was caught skimming off the top of the company's profits.
cards.exUz: Buxgalter kompaniya foydasidan ozgina o'g'irlashda qo'lga tushdi.
cards.uzDef: Pulni noqonuniy ravishda o'g'irlash, ayniqsa katta miqdordan ozgina qismini o'g'irlash.

cards.ex: The company is spread too thin; they need to focus on fewer projects.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya juda tarqalib ketgan; ular kamroq loyihalarga e'tibor qaratishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Resurslarni haddan tashqari ko'p narsalarga sarflash, yetishmaslik.

cards.ex: Before making a decision, we need to take stock of our current situation.
cards.exUz: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin, biz hozirgi vaziyatimizni baholashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni baholash, o'z imkoniyatlarini va muammolarni ko'rib chiqish.

cards.ex: The odds are stacked against them, but they're still determined to succeed.
cards.exUz: Imkoniyat kam, lekin ular hali ham muvaffaqiyat qozonishga qaror qilishgan.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat qiyin, muvaffaqiyatga erishish ehtimoli kam.

cards.ex: We're facing some financial difficulties, so we need to tighten our belts.
cards.exUz: Biz moliyaviy qiyinchiliklarga duch kelyapmiz, shuning uchun biz qimmatishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni kamaytirish, tejash rejimiga o'tish.

cards.ex: The promotion is up for grabs; anyone can apply.
cards.exUz: Lavozim erkin qo'l yetmas; har kim ariza topshirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Hali hech kimga tegishli bo'lmagan, erkin foydalanish mumkin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: With the new technology, it's a whole new ballgame for the industry.
cards.exUz: Yangi texnologiya bilan bu sanoat uchun butunlay yangi o'yin.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat butunlay o'zgargan, yangi qoidalar va sharoitlar paydo bo'lgan.

cards.ex: Their product quality is on a par with the leading brands.
cards.exUz: Ularning mahsulot sifati yetakchi brendlar bilan teng darajada.
cards.uzDef: Sifat, qiymat yoki daraja jihatidan teng bo'lish.

cards.ex: The environmental impact is really just a question of scale; a little pollution is manageable, but a lot is disastrous.
cards.exUz: Atrof-muhitga ta'siri aslida miqyos masalasidir; ozgina ifloslanishni boshqarish mumkin, lekin ko'p ifloslanish halokatli.
cards.uzDef: Muammoning kattaligi yoki miqdori asosiy omil bo'lgan vaziyat.
